# Steady 2.21.12

## What's new
- **ANR hard-lockdown** — fixes “Steady isn’t responding” under load:
  - Accessibility tree walks are capped, debounced, and never stacked
  - Allow/block package cache is in-memory (no SharedPreferences StringSet stalls on every event)
  - Day off / profile / Device Owner Binder work runs off the UI thread
  - Web filter list changes no longer restart the VPN tunnel
  - Gray-out refresh no longer re-applies the full Device Owner restriction storm
  - Sentry init and VPN establish moved off the critical main path
  - Privilege checks are cached briefly

## For parents
Install this build if you ever saw Close app / Wait. The app should stay light and responsive even with Accessibility + web filter on.
